description: Offline selective latency benchmark measuring oversized-cavity detection, per-flagged cavity splitting, and image-level latency without full unselective overhead.

single_cavity_split_latency_ms.bottleneck_note: Extreme tail latency is driven by sample-floorplan-house3 which has 3,687 Phase 2.10.4 proposals polygon-clipped against 17 cavities. For plans with normal proposal counts (1-500 proposals), per-cavity split is under 60ms.

per_image_selective_latency_ms.p50_sub_250ms_status: PASS for median image (24.5ms), but heavy outlier images with thousands of proposals exceed 250ms.

flagged_cavities_scaling.note: Contains 3,687 dense proposals clipped against 17 cavities

conclusion: Under normal proposal densities and for 8 out of 12 benchmark plans (<= 2 flagged cavities), selective cavity splitting runs in 4ms to 12ms. For median floorplans (P50 = 24.5ms total including detection), splitting is well under 250ms. However, unconstrained dense proposal pools create an extreme P99 tail (up to 393s) demonstrating that proposal deduplication/budget pruning (Phase 2.10.6) is strictly required before selective splitting can be deployed to production.
